name: ci-software
about: Checks `gamesfun verify --quick --profile .github/ci-profile.json` leaves out on a GitHub runner. The Linux and Windows runners have two processors and no graphics card (Chrome draws with SwiftShader, 1 to 2 frames a second); the macOS runner has three and a virtual card, and runs the same list (which of these checks it could run was not tried). A skipped check is recorded as skipped with its reason, never as passed, and the run is never a full pass. See docs/CI.md.
